## Build the workstation

Install and configure Linux on the classroom computer or use WSL on an appropriate personal Windows machine.

## Learn the computer through the operating system

Inspect the real machine with commands such as `lscpu`, `free -h`, `lsblk`, `df -h`, `lspci`, `ip addr`, and `uname -a`.

## Users, files, and packages

Work with the shell, directories, permissions, user accounts, software packages, storage, and networking as part of maintaining a usable technical environment.
